english.introCountA11y: This question has {blanks} blanks and {choices} answer choices.
english.introDropAreaA11y: Each blank is a drop area that must be filled with a single answer choice.
english.keyboardHelpA11y: Use TAB to move between answer choices and blanks, ENTER to select/drop, and ESC to cancel.
english.progressA11y: {filled} of {total} blanks have an answer choice.
english.blankFilledA11y: Blank {number} contains the answer choice {choice} end of answer choice
english.availableEndA11y: End of available answer choices. Use TAB to move to an answer choice.
english.selectedA11y: Selected answer choice {choice}. Use TAB to choose a blank.
english.overBlankA11y: Selected blank {number}. Press ENTER to move selected answer choice {choice} here or TAB to move to a different blank.
english.overPoolFromBlankA11y: Press ENTER to remove selected answer choice from blank {number} or TAB to move to a different blank. Selected answer choice: {choice}
english.overPoolUnplacedA11y: Press ENTER to leave selected answer choice unplaced or TAB to move to a blank. Selected answer choice: {choice}
english.movedA11y: Moved answer choice {choice} from blank {from} to blank {to}.
english.remainingA11y: {filled} of {total} blanks have an answer choice. {available} available answer choices. Use TAB to select an answer choice.
english.completeA11y: Answer is complete. {total} of {total} blanks have an answer choice.
english.deselectedA11y: Answer choice {choice} is no longer selected. Use TAB to select an answer choice.
